eis_specs.document_title: Blind Creek Solar Farm And Battery Energy Storage System — SSD source (v3.31.0 hybrid source-hunt)
eis_specs.notes: Solar 350 MWac. BESS 300 MW / 600 MWh (2.0h duration). Regime: SSD. SSD-13166280 at 114 Currandooley Rd, Bungendore (~8 km NE of Bungendore, ~32 km NE of Canberra). 350 MW solar + 300 MW/600 MWh BESS on 1,026 ha site (682.5 ha footprint). Construction ~12-18 months. Owned by Ms BCSF Holdings/Blind Creek Solar Farm Trust; assumed CIS-linked.
